'''Arhul Crace''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Along with a squad of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], he was sent to capture the leading members of the [[Osaji Syndicate]] and tracked them through [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]] and [[Centares/Legends|Centares]], before confronting [[Osaji Hux]] on [[Muskree]].
